item.title: Power Crisis, Immigration Probe, Gardner Indictment
item.ns0:title: Power Crisis, Immigration Probe, Gardner Indictment
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, frustration boils over as residents reject "unrealistic" calls to cut back on cooling during a sweltering heatwave while political leaders trade barbs over the failing power grid. We delve into a brewing scandal at the Department of Immigration following allegations of abuse and bribery and hear the defiant response from electric vehicle owners being blamed for the nation’s energy woes. Plus, we bring you an exclusive, heartbreaking plea for closure from the family of a plane crash victim and go one-on-one with the rising star behind the nation’s newest musical anthem.
-----
